decisions.reason: A coupling protection cap is a simple accessory that builds directly on the firm's trailer coupling knowledge, costs little to keep, and complements the core range.
A box car trailer series is core to a medium German trailer maker, rests fully on its existing design and production knowledge, and is featured on the home page.
A car transporter is close to the firm's trailer expertise but more specialised and only shown on a page of its own, so it carries somewhat more risk, though early results do not justify dropping it.
A low-bed trailer series uses the firm's chassis and axle knowledge directly, and its home page prominence signals strategic importance.
A high trailer cover series extends the existing trailer line with related know-how and is featured on the home page.
This second box car trailer series sits within the firm's core competence, though overlap with Product B slightly raises the chance of consolidation.
